edits.old: Then the answer is 404 and nothing changes
edits.new:
Then the answer is 404 and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC5 Rules BR5 to BR14 of section 8 hold on every movement (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR5 to BR14 of section 8 are in force
    When the caller sends the POST for notice "N-0101"
    Then each rule BR5 to BR14 is applied as section 8 states it, and a rule that refuses the movement leaves nothing changed

  Scenario: AC6 The provided operations answer 401, 403 or 404 on their errors (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller is not authenticated, or holds no Documents right, or notice "N-0101" is outside the scope of the caller
    When the caller sends the POST or the GET of notice "N-0101"
    Then the answer is 401 when the caller is not authenticated, 403 when the caller holds no Documents right, and 404 when the notice is outside the scope of the caller

  Scenario: AC7 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the POST for notice "N-0101" with an Idempotency-Key has recorded movement "CM-0101"
    When the same POST is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second movement is recorded

  Scenario: AC8 A failed or unanswered call to the document hub records nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-document contract mock does not answer within the 2 s budget or returns an error
    When the caller sends the POST for notice "N-0101"
    Then nothing is recorded and the movement is never answered as recorded

  Scenario: AC9 A movement for a notice outside the eligible states is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given notice "N-0101" is not in an eligible state
    When the caller sends the POST for notice "N-0101"
    Then the movement is refused and nothing changes
